Intro.about: I am a passionate Full-Stack Developer dedicated to building robust, high-performance, and visually stunning web applications. With expertise spanning modern front-end frameworks and solid back-end architecture, I bridge the gap between design and technology. I focus on writing clean, scalable code and delivering exceptional, pixel-perfect user experiences.
